Title: EMBEDDED SOFTWARE INTERN – MEMORY SEAT MODULES
Description: Location FORVIA HELLA is a listed international automotive supplier. As a company of the FORVIA Group, FORVIA HELLA stands for high-performance lighting technology and vehicle electronics and, with the Lifecycle Solutions Business Group, also covers a broad service and product portfolio for the spare parts and workshop business as well as for manufacturers of special vehicles. With currently around 36,500 employees at over 125 locations, the Company is active worldwide and generated adjusted sales of €8.1 billion in fiscal year 2024. YOUR TASKS We are looking for a motivated Embedded Software Intern to support activities related toMemory Seat Modules kind of products within the Body Control Product Segment. This internship offers an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in automotive embedded software development, working with a multidisciplinary team responsible for delivering body electronics products for automotive applications. This role is ideal for a student who is interested in embedded systems, automotive electronics, real-time software, and product development processes. Your Qualifications Education Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in: Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related field Technical Skills Basic understanding of embedded systems and microcontroller-based software development. Knowledge of programming in C is required; exposure to C++ or Python is a plus. Basic understanding of real-time systems and embedded software architecture. Familiarity with debugging concepts, software testing, and issue analysis. Basic knowledge of communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, or UART is a plus. Understanding of version control systems (e.g., Git) is an advantage. Familiarity with automotive development tools, debuggers, or trace tools is a plus. Basic knowledge of software development lifecycle and requirements-based development is preferred. Soft Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Good communication and teamwork abilities. Eagerness to learn and grow in a technical environment. Structured, proactive, and detail-oriented working style. Ability to manage assigned tasks with guidance and ownership. Languages English: Intermediate to advanced level, both written and spoken. Even if you do not meet all our requirements, do not hesitate to apply to us, because the further development of our employees is very important to us and opens up a wide range of opportunities for you in our company. FORVIA HELLA stands for the variety of all employees. Inclusion and diversity are firmly anchored in our company culture. We are continuously looking for new team players and welcome applications from all interested parties, regardless of their ethical and social background, age, religion, gender, disability, sexual orientation or identity. Please send us your application via our career portal, stating your salary requirements and earliest possible starting date, with the reference number req18398. HELLA Automotive Mexico S.A. de C.V. RUBELIA YADIRA NAVARRO MALDONADO

Title: Ingeniero en soporte odoo
Description: Descripción del puesto En el puesto de Ingeniero en soporte Odoo en Fashion Beauty Group te encargarás del soporte funcional y técnico diario del ERP Odoo para las distintas áreas de la empresa. Darás seguimiento a incidencias, registrarás tickets, analizarás problemas y propondrás soluciones estables y documentadas. Configurarás módulos, flujos de trabajo y reportes en Odoo, así como pruebas y validación de nuevas funcionalidades antes de pasarlas a producción. Colaborarás con equipos internos de finanzas, logística, ventas y almacén para adaptar Odoo a sus necesidades operativas. Este es un puesto de dedicación a tiempo completo, presencial, en nuestras instalaciones en Zapopan, JAL. Requisitos Experiencia previa dando soporte a Odoo (u otros ERPs) a nivel funcional y/o técnico, resolviendo incidencias del día a día. Conocimientos en bases de datos (preferiblemente PostgreSQL), nociones de programación (Python o similar) y comprensión de integraciones mediante APIs. Capacidad de análisis de procesos de negocio (ventas, compras, inventario, contabilidad) y de traducción de necesidades de las áreas usuarias a configuraciones en Odoo. Aptitudes de comunicación y trato con personas usuarias, capacidad para explicar soluciones de forma clara y sencilla, y orientación al servicio. Capacidad para trabajar en equipo, organización y gestión del tiempo, atención al detalle y actitud proactiva para aprender y mejorar procesos. Valorable formación técnica o universitaria en informática, ingeniería, sistemas o similar, así como experiencia en implantación de proyectos ERP.

Title: Mid Level QA IRC296173
Description: Description We are seeking a mid-level test engineer to join our team and contribute to a new project focused on testing Linux-based systems with associated applications. Our team will be involved in an international initiative to develop a custom embedded system and applications for multimedia devices. The project aims to create an innovative solution for these devices based on a new Linux distribution built within the Yocto environment. As a member of the QA team, you will be responsible for testing and monitoring system components and applications, specifically examining performance, load, and stress to identify any bottlenecks or crashes. Join us if you’re interested in cutting-edge IoT technologies! Requirements – Solid knowledge of Python scripting with at least 3-5 years of experience. – Experience working with embedded and/or Android devices. – Proficiency in using the Linux shell, including navigation, basic commands, operations, and an understanding of syntax and conventions. – General experience with Linux, either from a development or user perspective. – Familiarity with bash scripting. – Very good command of the English language, at least at a B2 level (both written and spoken). – Strong analytical skills and the ability to connect the dots. **Preferred Skills:** – Experience with Yocto. – Experience in performance/load testing of Linux components. – Experience using ADB and developing Android applications. Job responsibilities – Designing, implementing, and deploying automated tests that simulate end-user operation for system components and applications. – Creating and implementing automated solutions for systems and applications in development. – Monitoring performance under load conditions. – Tracking the system and applications for crashes or bottlenecks. – Detecting, describing, and reporting various issues related to overall system performance, operation, and other malfunctions. What we offer Exciting Projects: Come take your place at the forefront of digital transformation! With clients across all industries and sectors, we offer an opportunity to work on market-defining products using the latest technologies. Collaborative Environment: Expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities! Work-Life Balance: GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules.We offer you the best quality of work life so that you exceed the expectations of our clients, while achieving your professional and personal ambitions. Professional Development: Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes English classes, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings. We also offer the chance to travel internationally Excellent Benefits: We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, extended paternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses. About GlobalLogic GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.
